text:
lia: Quick sync for Locksmith integration: need to confirm SAML binding, SCIM provisioning scope, and HSM attestation before we schedule marketplace listing. Who can take cert exchange?

omar: I can handle SAML. Ask Locksmith for metadata + signing cert. Plan SP-initiated first, then IdP flow.

frank: On SCIM we only need user CRUD and group membership for "service-accounts" in MVP. Please provide sample payload. Also need rate limit expectations.

locksmith-rep: We support HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings. SCIM v2 supported with pagination and rate limit header X-RateLimit-Remaining. Uploading metadata + sample SCIM payload to ticket LM-212.

ops-bot: Note: attach HSM attestation and KMIP endpoint docs to the ticket for security review.

lia: Good. Action items:
- omar: get metadata from Locksmith and run SAML smoke in partners-stg (tomorrow 10am PT)
- frank: prepare SCIM CSV -> will run bulk import test after SAML green
- locksmith-rep: add HSM attestation + KMIP test endpoint to LM-212

locksmith-rep: Done — uploaded attestation and KMIP test info.

omar: I'll provision locksmith-stg and kick off SAML tests at 10am. Will post results here.

frank: Once SCIM passes, marketing wants 2 screenshots and a 1-paragraph blurb for the marketplace page. Lia can you draft the blurb?

lia: Yep, will draft the blurb after QA sign-off. Note: legal requested 7-day embargo after final review.

locksmith-rep: We can provide a short HSM FAQ and compliance summary for the listing.

lia: OK closing for now — ping if any blockers.
